attchmntText: Sunflag Iron And Steel Company Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: Sunflag Iron And Steel Company Limited
voiceSummary: Sunflag Iron and Steel Company Limited, BSE code 500404, NSE code SUNFLAG, approved its unaudited financial results for the second quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors held its 208th meeting on November 13, 2026, at its registered office in Nagpur. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and subjected to a limited review by statutory auditors Lodha and Co LLP. The auditors issued an unmodified conclusion. The company reported a net profit after tax of 5,833 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the net profit after tax was 13,882 lakhs. The basic and diluted earnings per share were 3.24 for the quarter and 6.79 for the half year. The financial statements are available on the company website.
